_note: aax-bing-1 is a dusk street scene with a church tower (from an Expedia car-rental page), not the airport.

aax-bing-2.webp.zh: 阿拉沙机场航站楼内的候机区：值机柜台前排着队，成排的金属座椅对面是通往机坪的玻璃门。
aax-bing-2.webp.en: Inside Araxá Airport's terminal: a queue at the check-in counter and rows of metal seats facing the glass doors out to the apron.

aax-bing-3.webp.zh: 阿拉沙机场俯瞰：单条沥青跑道穿过红土高原，跑道中段一旁是机坪与机库。
aax-bing-3.webp.en: Aerial view of Araxá Airport: a single asphalt runway across red-earth plateau country, with the apron and hangars alongside its midpoint.
